data_bindings.binding: Use the authoritative 12-symbol, M5, eight-week prospective extension exactly as specified.
Bind capture to the accepted Pepperstone account-native universe and account fingerprint.

minimal_acquisition_request.information_gain_justification: These are the authoritative structural-extension symbols selected to expand asset-class, schedule, liquidity, and opportunity-density coverage beyond the previously observed narrow panels; OHLC and volume are the minimum fields required for chronology validation and preregistered structural mechanism screening.

decision.external_gate: Obtain the specified authenticated read-only Pepperstone cTrader/Open API capture, hash-bind it to this proposal and the authorized account fingerprint, then stop before any outcome interpretation if provenance, completeness, or disjointness fails.

methodology.capital_boundary: Preserve one continuous EUR200 account semantics, realistic margin and free-margin accounting, and anti-ruin constraints for any later research simulation.
methodology.economic_boundary: Do not compute or promote shared-account economic outcomes, do not open a V2 identity, and do not use the completed six-symbol outer as an additional confirmatory dataset.
methodology.mechanism_selection: Evaluate multiple plausible mechanism families without selecting one in advance; freeze feature, target, admission, chronology, missing-data, and screening rules before inspecting price-derived outcomes.
methodology.purpose: Structural screening and mechanism discovery only

objective.goal: Use the authorized minimal Pepperstone account-native extension to assess structural opportunity density across the broader feasible universe without reopening C031, reusing the completed outer as a new dataset, or creating an economic identity.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The completed six-symbol outer is panel-specific and cannot close the session-gap family or the broader mechanism frontier; a disjoint 12-symbol broker-native capture provides the highest information gain while preserving the frozen account, data, and economic boundaries.
